name: Lancium
industry_role: powered-land / AI data center developer (Nvidia- and Blue Owl-backed)
notes: Privately held; founded 2017/2018 as a demand-response energy-tech company that used bitcoin mining as its first flexible-load application (325MW Fort Stockton, TX site, 2021) -- not a public "crypto miner" pivot in the CIFR/RIOT sense, but flagged alongside them since bitcoin mining was its original revenue source. Partnered with Crusoe Energy (2024) on the 1.2GW "Clean Campus" near Abilene, TX -- the flagship site for OpenAI's Stargate project. Crusoe separately secured $11.6B in debt/equity for the campus.
